_doc: Canonical phone = E.164 digits without '+'. SHARED VERBATIM by MadarRust (Rust + SQL phone_canonical), madar rust-core, and MadarDashboard src/lib/phone.ts. Never edit one copy alone. Rule, in order: (1) raw longer than 32 chars -> invalid; (2) map Arabic-Indic (U+0660-0669) and Extended Arabic-Indic (U+06F0-06F9) digits to ASCII; (3) keep ASCII digits only; (4) strip a leading '00'; else keep if it starts with '20'; else a leading '0' becomes '20'; else exactly 10 digits starting with '1' gets '20' prefixed; else unchanged; (5) result length outside [10,15] -> invalid; (6) Egyptian mobile guard: a result starting with 2010, 2011, 2012 or 2015 must be exactly 12 digits, else invalid (a truncated or over-long mobile is the commonest typo; landlines such as 2013xxxxxxx are untouched).
